preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The sum of edge weights s must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the edges must be within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The calculated diameter must be within an absolute or relative error of 10^-6 compared to the expected value.
The diameter must be a non-negative real number.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= n <= 10**5","description":"The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= s <= 10**9","description":"The sum of edge weights s must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"len(edges) == n - 1","description":"The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)","description":"All vertex indices in the edges must be within the range [1, n]."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"abs(diameter - (s / (n - 1))) <= 1e-6","description":"The calculated diameter must be within an absolute or relative error of 10^-6 compared to the expected value."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"diameter >= 0","description":"The diameter must be a non-negative real number."}],"invariants":[]}
